theorem: theorem rodrigues_endpoint_jets (n k : ℕ) (hk : k < n) : ((derivative^[k]) ((X : ℝ[X]) ^ n * (1 - X) ^ n)).eval 0 = 0 ∧ ((derivative^[k]) ((X : ℝ[X]) ^ n * (1 - X) ^ n)).eval 1 = 0
assumptions: coefficient ring is Real; polynomial variable is dimensionless t
proof_target: Both endpoint jets of the Rodrigues kernel t^n(1-t)^n vanish for every derivative order k<n, using exact polynomial divisibility and evaluation at 0,1.

math_audit.normalization: none in this algebraic lemma; later shifted-Legendre map is S_n((1-mu)/2) and interval moment keeps 2*pi
math_audit.limits: n=0 has no k<n case; n>0 endpoints covered
